notes: A suffix stands on הִתְיַחְשָׂם, so it takes *them* under rule 18 and only the relative joins the infinitive's unit; vv. 17–19, which write no suffix, give the whole supplied *them that* to the infinitive under rule 46.
דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ is compressed: the resumptive phrase (s026–s028) is unrepresented under rule 22 and the supplied verb *required* is added under rule 20.
*even* is placed on the appositional לְ standing on the phrase it introduces rather than marked added; the unit note records the competing reading.
